chapter_title_en: The War Sword Sweeps the World
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch 362: The Stone Statue Awakens and Wields a War Sword
chapter_meta_description: The Little Defiant Dragon defends Xiao Chen's statue from cultivators seeking the Twenty-Four War Swords. Then the statue comes alive, pulling a sword and attacking! An epic reunion and vengeance.
og_title: World of Immortality: Chapter 362 – Wielding the War Sword, Sweeping the World
og_description: The stone statue of Xiao Chen awakens, gripping a war sword. The Little Defiant Dragon fights desperately to protect it. A mythic resurrection begins.
twitter_description: The legendary war swords are sensed, triggering a battle. Then the statue pulls a sword – and the world trembles. Little Defiant Dragon's finest moment.
